items.prompt: Attitude and DG unreliable when VAC light is on.
If roughness disappears on a single mag, adjust power and continue.
If engine quits on one mag: throttle IDLE, mixture IDLE CUTOFF, then mags BOTH and restart.
If severe roughness persists, LAND as soon as practicable.
If oil pressure is normal, may be a faulty gauge.
Prepare for possible engine failure if temperature stays high.
Below 25 PSI: expect engine failure. Proceed to Power Off Landing.
Suspect when engine runs only with boost pump ON.
Lean when reducing power, enrich when adding power.
Repeat until GEAR DOWN light ON (12-20 pulls). Stop when resistance is felt.
Do NOT operate gear electrically with manual system engaged.
Both gear lights on and warning horn on.
If retraction won't start, check emergency extension lever position.
Door trails ~3" open; handling is not affected. Return and land normally.
Exit icing conditions. Don't use ram air again until all ice has melted.

items.expectation: HIGHWAYS, GOLF COURSES, FIELDS, NEAR PUBLIC ACCESS

items.prompt: If no fire or engine seizure is suspected, attempt Air Start.
If unable to restart, continue with items D, E, G.
Glide: gear UP, flaps UP, cowl flaps CLOSED. 91/88/85 KIAS at 2740/2500/2300 LBS.
If engine does not restart, proceed to Power Off Landing.
If no improvement, LAND as soon as practicable.
If engine does not restart, best glide and Power Off Landing.
Extinguish with fire extinguisher. Abandon if fire continues.
If fire persists: increase glide speed, open cowl flaps. NO RESTART.
No stall or gear warning with master OFF.
If power is essential: master ON, then essential switches ON one at a time.
Up to 45 lbs of control force may be needed.
Hold anti-spin controls until rotation stops. Up to 2000 ft may be lost.
